explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma saying that an integral ring hom R →+* S gives ringKrullDim S ≤ ringKrullDim R. I read the declarations in Mathlib/RingTheory/KrullDimension/Basic.lean. The closest is `ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective`, which needs a surjective map and does not cover the integral case. I also grepped all of Mathlib for any line that mentions ringKrullDim, krullDim or KrullDimLE together with IsIntegral, isIntegral, Integral or Finite. The only hits were unrelated `FiniteDimensionalOrder` lemmas. Nothing turned up in the KrullDimension directory or in Ideal/GoingUp.lean either. Mathlib does have the ingredients the library's proof uses, `Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono` and `Ideal.comap_lt_comap_of_integral_mem_sdiff`. Putting them together takes a short argument of its own, so this does not count as a single-declaration special case.
